command: env -u PYTHONPATH ETLANTIC_CP_TEST_URL=<isolated PostgreSQL service URL> ETLANTIC_PHASE058_INSTALLED_BACKEND_PLUGIN=1 /tmp/phase058-final-wheel-venv/bin/python -m pytest -o pythonpath= -q tests/prefect -m prefect
result: The final installed-wheel Prefect suite passed: 32 passed in 45.34s, including the live Process-worker cancellation-at-commit trace.
assertions: A live Process worker staged replacement rows and its effect-ledger entry in a PostgreSQL transaction; a second connection observed no uncommitted rows while the worker was paused before commit.
The authorized durable cancellation request was observed by the worker while the transaction remained paused; after release, PostgreSQL committed exactly one replacement and one effect-ledger record.
Canonical execution retained one cancelled attempt and a cancelled report, while the durable effect remained classified as committed; cancellation did not trigger a second write attempt.

runtime.prefect_server: Separately supervised Prefect API with PostgreSQL persistence

limitations: This covers cancellation after the writer has staged an atomic PostgreSQL transaction and while it is paused at commit; cancellation during staging and before durable report publication remain open.
The evidence does not qualify non-transactional connector effects, external policy-service revocation, or production release compatibility.
cleanup: The integration test uses unique tenant, workspace, submission, deployment, database, table, and effect-ledger identities.
The temporary Prefect PostgreSQL database is dropped after the campaign.
